title: 第13章 做人如刀当杀则杀第14章 少爷田九
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“姑娘，你是分不出来善恶？他要抢你，我要救你，然后你反过来要弄死我？”周元挺身而出，并没有挟恩图报的打算，但你也不能恩将仇报吧。
这女人脑子是不是有什么问题？
“你是邪修！”
“我只是修了血术。”
“修了血术，就是邪修。邪修，必须死。”女子咬牙，看着面前妄图辩解的少年，就像她已经被用过了一样，满眼都是敌意。
“这是什么狗屁道理！血术是人在用，用之正，则正，用之邪，则邪。”
“你跟灵宗解释去吧。”
“你个贱人……”
“你敢骂我！”
“贱货，你敢动手，我弄死你！”周元突然朝着男人冲了过去，既然要打，就别磨蹭。而打群架的精髓，先抓住最强的往死里揍。
“拦住他！”
男人立刻喝斥女子，替他试探这小子的学术究竟有多强，又有多诡异。
“站住！”女子却只是喊了一嗓子，摆出防御姿态，没有真的冲出去。那可是血修，再小也是血修。
周元体内血炼诀疯狂运转，磅礴血气逆冲窍穴，一股磅礴血气刹那间汹涌，席卷山谷，同时大声喝斥：“血煞，九重天！”
好强的血气。
他是九重天？
开什么玩笑？
可滚滚血雾扑面而来，隐隐似有血色巨蟒在翻腾，狰狞嘶啸，声势非常骇人。
该死的，这些歹毒的血修果然不能用常理揣度，小小年纪，竟能打出九重天的威势？
“给我破！！”

男子双臂引动尘雾，化作两道重拳，悍然阻击血蛇。
嘭！
血蟒崩碎，化作血雾散开。
等等，不对！
这特么是九重天？
感觉就像是砸到了松软的棉花上，完全没有遭到任何阻力。反倒是他由于用力过猛，一个踉跄失去平衡，朝着前面扑了过去。就在这刹那之间，溃散的血雾里雷光爆闪，那少年出现在了他的身旁。
“雷噬！”
周元身缠雷潮，跟前扑的男子擦身而过，右手雷电如漩涡般乱窜，击向了男子喉咙。
男子境界比他高太多了，完全能形成碾压，轻易弄死他，但是聚灵境界还没有强到刀枪不入的程度，只要不是灵法对轰，而是创造出机会，再抓住机会，精准地击到要害，可杀！
噗嗤！！
雷噬在喉咙爆开，鲜血喷溅，男子仰面翻腾，重重砸在了地上。他死死捂住喷血的喉咙，眼里满是惊恐和愤怒。
这小子的血术并不强，真的只是初学，可是那一嗓子……
太特么混蛋了。
他吓唬我。
“你真是九重天？”周元一脸疑惑的看着男子。
content_en:
"Girl, you can't tell the difference between good and evil? He wants to rob you, I want to save you, and then you want to kill me?" Zhou Yuan stepped forward and had no intention of repaying kindness, but you can't repay kindness with enmity.
Is there something wrong with this woman's brain?
"You are an evil cultivator!"
"I just practiced blood magic."
"If you practice blood magic, you are an evil cultivator. Evil cultivators must die." The woman gritted her teeth and looked at the young man in front of her who was trying to defend herself. It was as if she had already been used, and her eyes were full of hostility.
"What nonsense is this! Blood magic is used by people. If it is used correctly, it will be good, and if it is used evilly, it will be evil."
"Explain it to Lingzong."
"You bitch..."
"How dare you scold me!"
"Bitch, if you dare to take action, I'll kill you!" Zhou Yuan suddenly rushed towards the man. Since he wanted to fight, he shouldn't wait any longer. The essence of a group fight is to grab the strongest one first and beat him to death.
"Stop him!"
The man immediately scolded the woman and tried to test for him how strong and weird this kid's academic skills were.
"Stop!" The woman just shouted, put on a defensive posture, and did not really rush out. That is blood cultivation, no matter how small it is, it is still blood cultivation.
The Blood Refining Technique in Zhou Yuan's body was running wildly, and the majestic blood energy rushed back into the acupoints. A wave of majestic blood energy surged instantly and swept across the valley. At the same time, he shouted loudly: "Blood Evil, Ninth Level Heaven!"
What a strong spirit.
Is he Jiuchongtian?
Are you kidding me?
But the billowing blood mist rushed towards my face, and it seemed like a bloody giant python was writhing, hissing ferociously, and the sound was very terrifying.
Damn it, these vicious blood cultivators really can't be judged by common sense. How can they achieve the power of the Nine Heavens at such a young age?
"Break it for me!!"
The man's arms aroused the dust mist, which turned into two heavy punches to block the blood snake.
Bang!
The blood python collapsed into pieces and dispersed into blood mist.
Wait, that’s not right!
Is this the Nine Heavens?
It felt like hitting soft cotton without any resistance at all. Instead, he stumbled and lost his balance due to excessive force, and threw himself forward. At this moment, lightning flashed in the dispersing blood mist, and the young man appeared beside him.
"Thunder bite!"
Zhou Yuan was wrapped in thunder waves and passed by the man rushing forward. The thunder and lightning in his right hand flew around like a whirlpool and hit the man's throat.
The man's realm is much higher than him, and he can completely crush him and easily kill him, but the spirit-gathering realm is not so strong that he is invulnerable. As long as it is not a spiritual attack, but an opportunity is created, seize the opportunity, and hit the vital point accurately, he can be killed!
Poof! !
Thunder bite exploded in the throat, blood spurted out, the man rolled on his back and hit the ground hard. He clutched his throat that was spurting blood, his eyes filled with fear and anger.
This kid's blood skills are not strong, he is really just a beginner, but that voice...
What a bastard.
He scares me.
"Are you really the ninth heaven?" Zhou Yuan looked at the man with confusion.
